Developer Analyst I
Date:  Nov 20, 2026

Houston, TX, US, 77010

Company:  NRG

Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re all about propelling the next generation of leaders forward. We are driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future. We deliver innovative solutions that make our customers’ lives easier—helping them power, protect, and intelligently manage their homes and businesses. To do this, we need creative and talented people to join our company.

We offer a dynamic work environment and a unified and inclusive culture. NRG fosters a strong sense of belonging that leads to better collaboration and business performance. In everything we do, we aim to champion our employees and bring value to our customers, investors and society.

More information is available at www.nrg.com. Connect with NRG on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and X.

Role Summary:

The AI-Enabled Developer Analyst I is an entry-level technology professional responsible for supporting the design, development, testing, implementation, and maintenance of software applications, integrations, automations, and digital solutions within NRG's Consumer Energy business. Working as part of a cross-functional product team, this role partners with business stakeholders, product owners, developers, architects, and quality assurance teams to deliver technology solutions that enhance customer experience, improve operational efficiency, and support business growth.

 

This position is expected to leverage approved Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automation tools to improve productivity, accelerate software delivery, enhance solution quality, and streamline development processes. The AI-Enabled Developer Analyst I will utilize AI-assisted capabilities for coding, debugging, documentation, analysis, testing, and continuous improvement while maintaining appropriate human oversight and adherence to NRG's cybersecurity, data privacy, and responsible AI standards.

 

This role provides an excellent opportunity for early-career professionals to develop technical expertise while gaining exposure to modern software engineering practices, AI-enabled development, cloud technologies, enterprise applications, agile delivery methods, and the retail energy industry.

Responsibilities:
Design, develop, test, implement, maintain, and support software applications, integrations, APIs, reports, automations, and other technology solutions across Consumer Energy platforms.
Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, architects, and subject matter experts to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
Troubleshoot application defects and production incidents by performing root cause analysis, implementing corrective actions, and validating resolutions.
Develop and execute unit, integration, and regression testing activities while participating in code reviews and adhering to established development, security, and quality standards.
Create and maintain technical documentation, development standards, support procedures, and other solution-related artifacts.
Participate in Agile delivery processes, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, retrospectives, and demonstrations.
Monitor application performance, identify enhancement opportunities, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives through automation, optimization, and modern engineering practices.
Utilize approved AI-assisted development tools to support solution design, coding, debugging, testing, documentation, and productivity improvements.
Evaluate and validate AI-generated code, technical recommendations, and development artifacts for accuracy, security, maintainability, compliance, and alignment with NRG standards.
Partner with business, product, and architecture teams to identify and implement AI-enabled automation, process improvements, and innovative technology solutions.
Continuously develop expertise in emerging technologies, AI capabilities, cloud platforms, DevOps practices, and software engineering best practices.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
0-3 years of experience in software development, application support, or technology delivery; internships, co-op programs, academic coursework, or personal development projects may be considered in lieu of professional experience.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality technology solutions.
Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt quickly in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Self-motivated and customer-focused, demonstrating curiosity, initiative, and a continuous learning mindset with an interest in emerging technologies and industry trends.
Ability to effectively leverage AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, solution quality, and decision-making while exercising sound technical judgment and validating AI-generated outputs.
Understanding of responsible AI principles, including data privacy, security, transparency, compliance, and appropriate human oversight to ensure AI-generated solutions align with business and technical requirements.
Preferred Qualifications:
Exposure to one or more programming languages such as ABAP, UI5, C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, or TypeScript.
Familiarity with SQL and relational databases.
Understanding of APIs, web services, and system integrations.
Experience with Git, Azure DevOps, GitHub, or other source control tools.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.
Knowledge of Agile development methodologies.
Experience developing applications, integrations, or automations through academic projects, internships, or personal projects.
Basic understanding of CI/CD and DevOps concepts.
Familiarity with SAP, Salesforce, or customer-facing enterprise applications is a plus.
Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, ChatGPT Enterprise, or similar productivity platforms.
Understanding of Generative AI concepts, prompt engineering, and responsible AI principles.
Familiarity with AI-enabled software development, automation, and workflow optimization.
Interest in leveraging AI to improve software quality, developer productivity, and business outcomes.
Working Conditions:
Hybrid work environment 4 days onsite or per business need.
Occasional evening or weekend support may be required during major releases or production incidents.
Limited travel may be required for team collaboration or business meetings.

 

The AI-Enabled Developer Analyst is designed as an entry point into NRG's Consumer Technology organization. Successful candidates will have opportunities to progress. This position provides foundational experience in enterprise technology delivery while supporting NRG's Consumer Energy strategic initiatives.

 

NRG Energy is committed to a drug and alcohol-free workplace.
